source_case.purpose: Native loadability gate plus fresh nested mood/channel inventory
steps: Parent/authorized lifecycle opens an owned disposable copy under the established fence; verify exact owned PID/hash/start/session and foreground/overlap guards.
Use frozen loxone-ux.py status/windows/inspect on that PID. Discover actual accessible dialog/element identities; do not guess lighting selectors, coordinates, units or capabilities.

Open only the owned LightController2 configuration dialog using discovered guarded selectors; record actual mood IDs and displayed channel/value forms for Slice A/Slice B. Keep XML Qn values as raw storage; do not equate packed integers with native GUI units.

Accept without editing, save-as a new owned output, reopen and retrieve that XML through the approved transfer path. Compare UUID/SID/CID/Outputs, all Qn, connector IDs and In references. Record all native normalizations explicitly.
source_case.stop: Unexpected dialog, missing target, UUID regeneration, external connection attempt or ambiguous readback blocks later executions. Do not claim the candidate project was loadable merely because CLI validation passed.
